description_en: Set to `1` to disable the "How is Claude doing?" session quality surveys. Surveys are also disabled when `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` is set. See [Session quality surveys](/en/data-usage#session-quality-surveys)
description_ja: 1を設定すると、セッション品質に関するアンケート(How is Claude doing?)の表示を停止します。
